paragraphs: R. Mana, Midrash Kohelet at 'Better that you should not vow.' He was a priest; see R. Yehudah Nesi'ah. I think he was R. Assi's student; see R. Tanḥum bar Pappa.
Since the Jerusalem Talmud sometimes mentions Mana and sometimes Mani concerning the same matter, I shall arrange both here alphabetically.
